newsitem.title: USA: Baker, Fentress sets distribution targets.
newsitem.headline: Baker, Fentress sets distribution targets.

text.p: Baker, Fentress & Co, a Chicago-based closed-end fund, said its board of directors approved a combined capital gain and ordinary income distribution target of 12 percent of average net assets for 1997 and 1998.
The target distributions will be based on average net assets for the 12 months ending October 31 of each year.
Baker Fentress said it has a policy of paying out a minimum of eight percent of average net assets. It said it expects to return to the normal eight percent distribution policy after 1998.
The exact amount of future distributions will depend on the board's judgment with respect to market conditions and results of operations, Banker, Fentress said.

Based on Baker Fentress's average net assets through May 31, a 12 percent distribution would approximate $2.68 a share in 1997, of which a $0.20 income dividend was paid on June 6, 1997. It is anticipated that an additional income dividend and capital gain distribution will be paid in December 1997.
